_provenance.source: production project kjzytnzkkdpdxtqtjlew, read-only pg_indexes query
_provenance.note: Standalone unique INDEXES (not constraints) — required by ON CONFLICT clauses in the 2.5.11 base function; the original mirror missed them because it captured constraints only.

indexes.name: extraction_manifest_run_unique
indexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX extraction_manifest_run_unique ON public.extraction_manifest USING btree (extraction_run_id)

indexes.name: idx_manifest_run
indexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_manifest_run ON public.extraction_manifest USING btree (extraction_run_id)  -- NOTE: production carries two duplicate unique indexes on the same column; mirrored once

indexes.name: extraction_run_document_version_unique
indexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX extraction_run_document_version_unique ON public.extraction_run USING btree (source_document_id, run_version)

indexes.name: extraction_run_replay_receipt_unique
indexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX extraction_run_replay_receipt_unique ON public.extraction_run USING btree (source_document_id, source_content_id, engine_version, rule_set_version, rule_manifest_hash, configuration_hash) WHERE ((source_content_id IS NOT NULL) AND (engine_version IS NOT NULL) AND (rule_set_version IS NOT NULL) AND (rule_manifest_hash IS NOT NULL) AND (configuration_hash IS NOT NULL))

indexes.name: extraction_run_config_run_unique
indexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX extraction_run_config_run_unique ON public.extraction_run_config USING btree (extraction_run_id)

indexes.name: layer_coverage_extraction_run_id_source_block_id_layer_name_key
indexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX layer_coverage_extraction_run_id_source_block_id_layer_name_key ON public.layer_coverage USING btree (extraction_run_id, source_block_id, layer_name)

indexes.name: validation_result_run_test_unique
indexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX validation_result_run_test_unique ON public.validation_result USING btree (extraction_run_id, test_name)
